statements.status_notes: ztunnel builds without enabling hickory-proto dnssec backends (dnssec-ring / dnssec-aws-lc-rs). The buggy NSEC3 walk inside DnssecDnsHandle is exercised only once an application wraps resolvers with DNSSEC verification; Istio ambient DNS forwarding in src/dns proxies lookups and echoes EDNS DO without running DnssecDnsHandle-backed validation paths.

Fixed in hickory-proto 0.26.1. Istio ztunnel releases 1.28.x/1.29.x ship the hickory 0.25 stack until upstream tags a stable release migrating to hickory 0.26 (upstream main/release-1.30 use hickory 0.26 / hickory-net); locally replacing the Hickory resolver stack inside this image would materially diverge from Istio-source behavior.
